note: Example glossary. Copy to glossary.json (gitignored) and fill with the terminology for the game/community the channel covers. Consumed by glossary.ts: canonical spellings feed the WhisperX initial_prompt; matched entries' definitions feed the analyzer and title prompts; term + aliases + misheard feed the new-video term-flagging step. category: person | level | difficulty | mechanic | version | song | reference. aliases = other correct names/spellings. misheard = transcription errors that should map back to this term. candidateStopwords = extra words to ignore when guessing new terms (e.g. the game's own name). wikiBaseUrl = base URL of the game's community wiki (e.g. a Fandom site), consumed by wikiLookup.ts to draft glossary entries from wiki articles.

entries.definition: A short description of who this person is and why they matter to the channel's audience.
A short description of this piece of user-created content — its reputation, creator, and what makes it notable.
What this game mechanic or piece of jargon means, in one or two sentences.
